name: Apollo Portal Console
description: Manage Apollo 2.x configuration with independently authored pages and password login. Known visual parity gaps remain.
releaseNotes: 0.1.3 stable: promotes the tested RC2 behavior without UI changes. Success feedback auto-dismisses after 5 seconds and successful editors close; app/Key search handles folded/text targets and multi-environment pagination. Retains measured menus, cluster rows and table repairs. Stable publication enables Store release discovery, not a full-parity claim: all-page/all-dialog 1:1 remains FAIL and native cold-start/file transfer/multi-account acceptance is incomplete. Author packages are unsigned inputs; official Store review, signing and merge remain required.

zh-CN.name: Apollo Portal 控制台
zh-CN.description: 独立编写 Apollo 2.x 管理页面，支持普通账号密码登录。全量页面及弹窗 1:1 对照仍有差距。
